article.title: SeenThis早期開放Studio MCP，把AI簡報接入可編輯影片廣告
article.title_en: SeenThis opens early access to Studio MCP for editable video ads from AI briefs
article.summary: 11月5日公告讓支援MCP的AI工具連接SeenThis Studio，素材經批准後再分發。
article.summary_en: The November 5 release connects MCP-compatible AI tools to SeenThis Studio, with approval before distribution.
highlights: 可製作不同格式、語言及優惠版本，並提供客戶預覽。
只限部分代理商及品牌，使用者須登入Studio帳戶。
highlights_en: Teams can create format, language and offer variants with client previews.
Access is limited to selected agencies and brands using their Studio accounts.
article.why: 代理商可把品牌要求與廣告製作規格放進同一流程，減少交接時遺漏版本要求的機會。
article.why_en: Agencies can connect brand requirements and ad production specifications in one workflow, reducing version handoff gaps.
article.next_step: 申請前先列出所需格式、追蹤及客戶批准流程，確認現有AI工具與Studio權限。
article.next_step_en: List formats, tracking needs and approval steps before requesting access, and check AI-tool and Studio permissions.
article.detail: MCP是讓AI工具連接外部軟件的協議。按SeenThis公告，AI工具帶入品牌資料，Studio提供製作模板與技術指引；團隊可審閱預覽，再把已批准的廣告從Studio送往DV360、Meta或TikTok。這並非所有用戶已可使用的無人投放服務。公告中的製作時間縮短比例屬公司早期測試，本報未作獨立驗證，因此不沿用為預期成效。
article.detail_en: MCP connects AI tools to external software. SeenThis describes brand context meeting Studio templates and technical guidance, with previews and approved delivery to DV360, Meta or TikTok. Limited early access is not unattended universal launch. Vendor production-time savings are omitted.
